fields.description: Issue dated October 6, 1928, published in Miami, Florida. Contains editorials and satirical local-political commentary, including discussion of hurricane history and storm risk in the Miami area; tourism and seasonal business conditions; municipal controversies in Coral Gables and Hialeah (police department disruption, taxpayer demands for accounting, and bond/deficit issues); Miami city commission actions and a proposed apartment-filling advertising scheme; a new Miami plumbing ordinance and licensing requirements; sports notes and promotion of local teams; entertainment and nightlife listings; and a letter regarding enforcement actions against illegal alligator killing along the Tamiami Trail/Everglades area.
